description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2021/03989/FUL granted 14th April 2023 for the 'Replacement of the existing metal railings on the rear-side elevations with 1.7m high obscure-glazed screening; upgrading the existing metal railings on the rear elevation to increase the height to 1.1m from the new floor level at second floor level; and the installation of new timber decking to the existing second floor roof terrace' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: retention and upgrading the existing metal balustrades with the previously approved 1.7m high obscure-glazed screening to be installed behind the retained balustrades.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission: A3/03 (proposed plans); A3/04 (proposed section); and A3/05 (proposed elevation) [all received 12.08.2026].

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 2 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on approved drawing nos. A3/03 (proposed plans); A3/04 (proposed section); and A3/05 (proposed elevation) [all received 12.08.2026]. The glass privacy screens shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along the flank elevations. The metal railing to the flank and rear elevations of the terrace shall have a height of 1.1m above the finished floor level of the terrace. The privacy screens shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
